related_topics: League-table forecasting, team ratings, and betting-market efficiency
Event and positional data, tracking, and tactical analysis
Possession, match context, and performance indicators
Prediction calibration, uncertainty, and out-of-sample evaluation
How analytics inform coaching and match decisions
Limits of observational data and the distinction between prediction and causation

papers.Title: Modelling association football scores
papers.Relevance rationale: Foundational modelling of team scoring strengths and match scores; a basis for later probabilistic score and outcome forecasts.

papers.Title: Modelling association football scores and inefficiencies in the football betting market
papers.Authors: Dixon, Mark J.; Coles, Stuart G.
papers.Publication venue: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series C (Applied Statistics)
papers.Relevance rationale: Introduced a influential dynamic score model and examined the relationship between statistical forecasts and betting-market prices.

papers.Title: Prediction and retrospective analysis of soccer matches in a league
papers.Publication venue: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series D (The Statistician)
papers.Relevance rationale: Developed a dynamic Bayesian framework for team abilities and match forecasts, linking changing form to score prediction.

papers.Title: Analysis of sports data by using bivariate Poisson models
papers.Publication venue: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series D (The Statistician)
papers.Relevance rationale: Shows how correlated team goal counts can be modelled jointly, improving probabilistic treatment of match scores.

papers.Title: Regression models for forecasting goals and match results in association football
papers.Relevance rationale: Evaluates regression approaches to forecasting goals and outcomes, providing a useful bridge between score modelling and practical prediction.

papers.Title: A Bayesian hierarchical model for the prediction of football results
papers.Relevance rationale: Uses hierarchical team effects to produce probabilistic forecasts and illustrates partial pooling across teams.

papers.Title: Using ELO ratings for match result prediction in association football
papers.Relevance rationale: Tests rating-based measures of team strength as predictors of match results and compares their forecasting value with other information.

papers.Title: pi-football: A Bayesian network model for forecasting association football match results
papers.Authors: Constantinou, Michael A.; Fenton, Norman E.; Neil, Martin
papers.Relevance rationale: Combines football knowledge and statistical evidence in a Bayesian network to estimate match-result probabilities.

papers.Title: A dynamic bivariate Poisson model for analysing and forecasting match results in the English Premier League
papers.Publication venue: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series A (Statistics in Society)
papers.Relevance rationale: Extends goal-based forecasting with time-varying team strengths and joint score modelling, directly addressing changing performance over a season.

papers.Title: Prediction of the FIFA World Cup 2014 – A random forest approach with an emphasis on chosen team composition
papers.Authors: Groll, Andreas; Schauberger, Gunther; Tutz, Gerhard
papers.Relevance rationale: Applies machine learning to tournament forecasting and investigates whether team composition contributes useful predictive information.

papers.Title: A machine learning framework for sport result prediction
papers.Relevance rationale: Reviews and applies machine-learning approaches to sports-result prediction, helping situate football forecasting among broader modelling methods.

papers.Title: Performance analysis in football: A critical review and implications for future research
papers.Relevance rationale: Critically reviews football performance-analysis methods and their limitations, including the challenge of translating observed indicators into actionable insight.

papers.Title: Match analysis in football: a systematic review
papers.Authors: Sarmento, Hugo; Marcelino, Rui; Anguera, M. Teresa; Campaniço, Jorge; Matos, Nuno; Leitão, José
papers.Relevance rationale: Synthesizes match-analysis research and its variables and methods, useful for understanding what performance measures can and cannot explain.

papers.Title: Game-related statistics that discriminated winning, drawing and losing teams from the Spanish soccer league
papers.Authors: Lago-Peñas, Carlos; Lago-Ballesteros, Joaquín; Dellal, Alexandre; Gómez, Miguel Ángel
papers.Relevance rationale: Examines which match statistics distinguish outcomes in league play, illustrating how indicators relate to results while remaining sensitive to context.

papers.Title: Big data and tactical analysis in elite soccer: future challenges and opportunities for sports science
papers.Relevance rationale: Discusses the opportunities and practical limits of using large-scale data for tactical analysis and decision support in elite football.

papers.Title: Data analytics in football: positional data collection, modelling and analysis
papers.Authors: Memmert, Daniel; Lemmink, K. A. P. M.; Sampaio, Jaime
papers.Relevance rationale: Reviews positional-data collection and analytical methods, connecting tracking data to tactical questions and performance assessment.

papers.Title: Spatio-temporal analysis of team sports
papers.Relevance rationale: Surveys computational approaches to spatial and temporal team-sport data, including methods relevant to football movement and tactics.

papers.Title: A public data set of spatio-temporal match events in soccer competitions
papers.Authors: Pappalardo, Luca; Cintia, Paolo; Ferragina, Paolo; Massucco, Emanuele; Pedreschi, Diego; Giannotti, Fosca
papers.Relevance rationale: Describes an open event-data resource that supports reproducible analysis of match events, player actions, and team performance.

papers.Title: Actions Speak Louder Than Goals: Valuing Player Actions in Soccer
papers.Authors: Decroos, Tom; Bransen, Lotte; Van Haaren, Jan; Davis, Jesse
papers.Publication venue: Proceedings of the 25th ACM SIGKDD International Conference on Knowledge Discovery & Data Mining
papers.Relevance rationale: Introduces VAEP, a framework for valuing actions by their change in the probability of scoring or conceding, extending analysis beyond goals and assists.

papers.Title: A goal scoring probability model for shots based on players' abilities in soccer
papers.Relevance rationale: Models shot-level scoring probability while incorporating player ability, relevant to expected-goals estimation and separating chance quality from finishing outcomes.
